properties.description: 지리펜스(geofence) 경계값 변경 이벤트에서 변경폭(ShiftAmount)이 UAV_Threshold_List 동적 임계(MaxGeofenceShift_m)를 초과하거나, Approved_Operators_List 상 approver/superadmin 권한이 없는 자(ChangedBy)의 변경을 탐지. MITRE: T0836
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let shiftGate = toscalar(_GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List') | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxGeofenceShift_m' | project toint(Value));
let ApprovedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | where Role in ('approver','superadmin') | project OperatorId;
UAVMiddleware_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == 'GeofenceChange'
| extend ShiftAmount = abs(toint(BoundaryValueAfter) - toint(BoundaryValueBefore))
| extend isUnapprovedChanger = ChangedBy !in (ApprovedOps)
| where ShiftAmount > shiftGate or isUnapprovedChanger
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    ShiftAmount > shiftGate and isUnapprovedChanger, strcat("지오펜스_대폭변경_비인가변경자_", ChangedBy),
    ShiftAmount > shiftGate, strcat("지오펜스_변경폭임계초과_", GeofenceId, "_shift:", ShiftAmount),
    strcat("지오펜스_비인가_변경자_", ChangedBy))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, GeofenceId, BoundaryValueBefore, BoundaryValueAfter, ChangedBy, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc
